duplicate_feature_action: remove purchase_frequency because it is exactly identical to unique_invoices; retain unique_invoices
model: same expanding-window median-imputed, standardized LogisticRegression(C=1.0,max_iter=500) as parent; no tuning
evaluation_and_metrics: same monthly cutoffs, leakage checks, reference probabilities, metrics, and cohorts as parent
negative_control: repeat parent within-training-cutoff label permutation independently for seeds 20260729 through 20260828 inclusive; refit at every cutoff
negative_control_summaries: per-cutoff 5th, median, and 95th percentile PR-AUC gain and ROC-AUC
per-cutoff fraction of controls at least as large as real duplicate-free model
maximum control excursion across cutoffs per seed
familywise fraction whose maximum PR-AUC gain is at least the original September 2010 control gain
interpretation_rule: The ranking conclusion survives duplicate removal if duplicate-free PR-AUC gain remains positive in at least 80% of cutoffs. Treat the September excursion as compatible with permutation variability if at least 5% of fixed repetitions have a maximum gain at least that large; otherwise retain it as an unusual falsification warning. Coefficients remain descriptive, and no causal, confirmatory, tuned, or hidden-holdout claim is allowed.
